note: Free help shown in the Taxes tab (SPEC §2.12). Draft: every URL, name and limit must be verified by the owner (docs/ANNUAL_RULES_REVIEW.md). verified=null items are never shown.

resources.name: IRS: Tax relief in disaster situations
resources.purpose: Check, by state, whether your area has extra time to file or pay.

resources.name: Taxpayer Advocate Service
resources.purpose: An independent organization within the IRS that helps with tax problems you can’t resolve on your own.

resources.name: IRS Free File
resources.purpose: Free guided tax software under an income limit (Fillable Forms at any income). Open during filing season, from January.

resources.name: VITA free tax preparation
resources.purpose: Free basic tax return preparation by IRS-certified volunteers, generally for people under an income guideline, people with disabilities, and limited English speakers. Sites may set their own limits.

resources.name: Tax Counseling for the Elderly (TCE)
resources.purpose: Free tax help, particularly for people 60 and older, with a focus on pensions and retirement questions.

resources.name: Low Income Taxpayer Clinics
resources.purpose: Independent clinics that help people whose income is below a certain level resolve IRS problems, free or for a small fee.

resources.name: IRS payment plans (installment agreements)
resources.purpose: An agreement with the IRS to pay what you owe over a longer time. Setup fees may apply; interest and penalties keep adding up until it’s paid.

resources.name: IRS Self-Employed Individuals Tax Center
resources.purpose: Who counts as self-employed, what you owe, quarterly payments and filing: the IRS’s starting point.

resources.name: IRS: Understanding your Form 1099-K
resources.purpose: The report of payments you got for goods or services through cards, payment apps or online marketplaces, and how to use it on your return.

resources.name: SCORE free business mentoring
resources.purpose: Free mentoring from experienced business mentors, plus business training.
resources.siteNote: This is not a government site. It asks for your location and may share usage data with advertising and analytics partners.
